verdict.rationale: Mollie's Settlement Report breaks down a single payout into its transactions, fees and deductions, and is described as a tool for reconciling transactions, so settlement-to-payout reconciliation with itemized fees is a first-party capability. A Chargebacks API for retrieving chargeback details and a Balances API for bookkeeping support this. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that refunds and chargebacks appear as line items in the settlement report (only implied by 'deductions'), explicit matching to bank deposits, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can reconcile settlements to bank deposits with itemized reports covering fees, refunds, and chargebacks

citations.quote: Settlement Report gives you a complete breakdown of the data included in a specific payout. It shows all transactions, fees and deductions that are part of a single settlement.
The Chargebacks API then allows you to retrieve details of the chargebacks that took place on your account.
This may be useful to for example integrate Mollie into your bookkeeping.
